items.teaser: Russische Sabotageakte und hybride Kriegsoperationen in Europa haben nach Angaben britischer Wissenschaftler am häufigsten Deutschland zum Ziel, gefolgt von Polen und den baltischen Staaten.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1737: Russian ballistic missiles hit a Kyiv shopping center and injure seven people in the city
items.teaser: Zelenskyy said US Patriot deliveries are still delayed, Ukraine's Neptune missiles hit a fourth Russian airbase in two weeks, and Kushner said the largest prisoner exchange of the war could come before the winter holidays.

items.teaser: Ukraine is preparing for the next prisoner-of-war exchange.

items.title: 11 Holodomor questions Russia doesn’t want you asking

items.title: Hungary joins coalition for return of abducted Ukrainian children following Magyar visit, Zelensky says
items.teaser: "Following my meeting with the Prime Minister of Hungary and, more broadly, what has effectively been a reset in relations between Hungary and Ukraine, our neighbors have joined our global coalition," President Volodymyr Zelensky.

items.title: Ukraine seeks additional weapons from partners to protect infrastructure, Zelensky says
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has stated that Ukraine, together with its partners in Europe and other countries, is working to secure additional arms packages, in particular to strengthen the protection of infrastructure against various types of drones.

items.title: Zelensky posthumously honors Kyiv-Mohyla Academy's Viacheslav Briukhovetsky, who helped restore Ukraine's educational heritage
items.teaser: Under Briukhovetsky's leadership, the National University of Kyiv-Mohyla Academy broke with the Soviet model of education in Ukraine, and became one of the country's most respected educational institutions.

items.title: Friedensforscher: EU hat "keine Exit-Option"
items.teaser: Die EU versuche zwar, fehlende Finanzhilfen der USA für die Ukraine auszugleichen. Sie habe aber keine klare Strategie für Verhandlungen, sagt Friedensforscher Sascha Hach bei ZDFheute live.

items.title: Zelensky warns Russia is preparing new large-scale attack
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has called on Ukrainians to pay close attention to air-raid sirens in the coming days, following reports that Russia is preparing a new large-scale attack.

items.title: Ukraine has almost nothing to stop Russia’s ballistic missiles, presidential tech adviser says, listing seven weapons Kyiv needs
items.teaser: The list ends with lasers to develop and study, a day after he reported a Ukrainian laser's first kill of a Russian jet-powered drone.

items.title: tagesschau 20:00 Uhr
items.teaser: Einigung im Tarifstreit der Metall- und Elektroindustrie, Staats- und Regierungschefs der 27 EU-Länder beraten bei Sondergipfel über EU-Haushalt, Pablo Hernández de Cos soll neuer Präsident der Europäischen Zentralbank werden, AfD-Richtungsstreit über Migration, Zwei Iraker nach Razzia wegen Terrorverdacht festgenommen

items.title: Mutter eines gefallenen amerikanischen Freiwilligen will in der Ukraine ein Buch herausgeben, zu dessen Schreiben sie von ihrem Sohn inspiriert wurde
items.teaser: Die Mutter des in der Ukraine gefallenen amerikanischen Freiwilligen Hayden Fischer Miller, die Schriftstellerin Laura Racey Miller, möchte in der Ukraine das Kinderbuch „Night of the Cricket“ veröffentlichen. Zum Schreiben ist sie von ihrem Sohn inspiriert worden, sagte sie auf einer Pressekonferenz in der Nachrichten

items.title: Ilona W. soll Putins Diensten Türen in Berlin geöffnet haben
items.teaser: In Berlin steht seit Donnerstag die mutmaßliche Spionin Ilona W. vor Gericht. Laut Anklage soll die 57-Jährige für den russischen Geheimdienst GRU spioniert haben. Der Prozessauftakt zieht sich in die Länge – auch weil Ilona W. plötzlich übel wird.

items.title: Russian forces strike factory in Khmelnytskyi region
items.teaser: In the Khmelnytskyi district, a fire broke out on the premises of one of the enterprises as a result of a Russian attack.

items.title: Ukraine’s Neptune missiles hit Russian airbase used for glide-bomb attacks – fourth airbase hit in two weeks
items.teaser: The airbase hosts Su-34 fighter-bombers used in Russian attacks on Ukrainian cities and military positions. Kyiv also reported hitting an oil pumping station more than 1,000 kilometers from its border.

items.title: Fire breaks out at business premises in Khmelnytskyi district following Russian attack
items.teaser: Firefighters are battling a blaze at a company's premises in Khmelnytskyi district after a Russian attack on 26 November, with no casualties reported.

items.title: Threatened by Wagner, this Nigerian journalist uncovered Russia’s war machine in Africa
items.teaser: When Yevgeny Prigozhin called Nigerian investigative journalist Philip Obaji Jr. a "cockroach" in 2022, the Wagner Group chief threatened to make him pay for his reporting. A year later, Obaji found himself locked inside a shipping container full of the insects, as well as rats, in the Central

items.title: Ukraine war latest: North Korea halts military aid to Russia, Ukrainian intelligence says
items.teaser: Key developments on Nov. 26: North Korea pauses military aid to Russia, Ukrainian intelligence says Ukraine strikes 2 Russian oil facilities, air field in Volgograd Oblast, General Staff confirms Russia prepares new mass attack on Ukraine's energy infrastructure, Zelensky says Zelensky appoints new commander of Ukraine

items.title: Ukraine invites Canada to join War Risk Insurance Fund
items.teaser: Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi has invited Canada to contribute to the War Risk Insurance Fund, which is due to be launched in January. Ukraine is also counting on an expansion of Canada’s preferential lending schemes and the attraction of investment into the private sector.

items.title: EU summit: decision on Ukraine postponed until December, €45bn loan and new mechanism discussed
items.teaser: EU leaders will delay a decision on a €45 billion loan for Ukraine until December while discussing a new mechanism for the 2028–2034 budget, sources say.

items.title: Ein Toter und vier Verletzte nach russischem Angriff auf Saporischschja
items.teaser: Heute haben russische Truppen die Stadt Saporischschja mit düsengetriebenen Drohnen angegriffen.

items.title: Dnipropetrovsk region comes under more than 50 attacks in one day, causing damage
items.teaser: Russian invaders launched more than fifty drone attacks on the Kryvyi Rih and Nikopol districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region throughout the day.

items.title: Zelensky appoints new commander of Ukraine's Support Forces
items.teaser: The post was previously held by Major General Dmytro Hereha, who served for nearly five years.

items.title: Ukraine, Russia could hold largest prisoner exchange of war before winter holidays, Kushner says
items.teaser: Budanov says Ukraine and Russia could carry out another exchange in the coming weeks, as Kyiv also explores a four-party meeting on peace involving European countries.

items.title: Russian strike on Komyshuvakha: Slidstvo.Info uncovers details about perpetrators
items.teaser: Slidstvo.Info uncovered details about Russian officers and pilots behind the 2 November airstrike on a school in Komyshuvakha that killed 72 people.

items.title: Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia kills one, injures four
items.teaser: Today, 26 November, Russian troops attacked Zaporizhzhia.

items.title: Ukrainian who set himself on fire in Warsaw is in intensive care in critical condition
items.teaser: Polish police confirmed the man who set himself on fire in Warsaw on 25 November is a Ukrainian citizen. He is in intensive care in critical condition.

items.title: Ukrainian NGOs urge EU to demand stronger reforms as Brussels reportedly accepts backsliding on rule of law
items.teaser: A Ukrainian civil society source familiar with the negotiations told the Kyiv Independent that representatives of the European Commission have succumbed to the Ukrainian authorities' pressure and agreed that "it was inappropriate to give international experts a decisive role in the selection of Supreme Court judges."

items.title: Trial of Berlin woman accused of spying for Russia begins after delay
items.teaser: Despite delays due to health issues, the trial of the Berlin woman accused of spying for Russia has begun. Prosecutors say the defendant used her military contacts to provide information on German defense and Ukraine.

items.title: Ukrainische Drohnen setzen Ölraffinerie in der russischen Region Krasnodar in Brand
items.teaser: In der Nacht zum 26. November haben Langstreckendrohnen des Militärgeheimdienstes (HUR) eine Ölraffinerie in der Stadt Slawjansk-na-Kubani in der Region Krasnodar attackiert.

items.title: Russia has lost nearly US$190bn in war against Ukraine – Russian media report
items.teaser: Russia spent RUB 43.6 trillion more on military needs over five years of war, losing RUB 18.6 trillion in unproductive spending, Novaya Gazeta Europe found.

items.title: Luftstreitkräfte zerstören Sammelbereich von russischen Truppen im Zentrum von Huljajpole
items.teaser: Das ukrainische Militär hat einen Luftangriff auf einen Sammelpunkt russischer Invasoren in der Stadt Huliaipole in der Region Saporischschja geflogen, teilt das 7. Schnelle Eingreifskorps der Luftlandetruppen auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Russian drones attack Dnipropetrovsk Oblast 50 times
items.teaser: Russian drones attacked two districts of Dnipropetrovsk Oblast more than 50 times on 26 November, damaging businesses, a kindergarten and infrastructure.

items.title: President Zelensky thanks Americans for their support in Thanksgiving message
items.teaser: Ukraine remains strong thanks to the support of many American friends.

items.title: Trump says he urged Putin to 'pull back' military aggression in Europe
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump claimed that he talked with Vladimir Putin about ceasing Russia's military aggression in Europe and expressed his belief in the possibility of a deal between Russia and Ukraine.

items.title: Trump's version of joint statement with Rutte urges both Ukraine and Russia to avoid actions that could expand war
items.teaser: Donald Trump's version of a joint statement with NATO chief Mark Rutte urges both Russia and Ukraine to avoid actions that could expand the war.

items.title: Ukraine hits Russian refinery in Krasnodar Krai, setting fire to key facilities
items.teaser: Drones of the Defense Intelligence of Ukraine (DIU) attacked an oil refinery in the city of Slavyansk-on-Kuban in Russia’s Krasnodar Krai overnight on November 26.

items.title: Italy, Germany caution against geographical expansion of Russia's war against Ukraine
items.teaser: Both Meloni and Wadephul reaffirmed their commitment to continue supporting Ukraine.

items.title: Russians attack Zaporizhzhia in the evening, killing one and injuring four
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Zaporizhzhia's Dniprovskyi district on the evening of 26 November, killing one person and injuring four, local authorities reported.

items.title: Militärgeheimdienst: Nordkorea setzt Militärhilfe für Russland, insbesondere Lieferung von ballistischen Raketen aus
items.teaser: Nordkoreas Außenministerin Choe Son Hui hat die Aussetzung der Militärhilfe an Russland angekündigt. Diese Entscheidung sei persönlich von Nordkoreas Machthaber Kim Jong-un getroffen worden, wie der ukrainische Militärgeheimdienst (HUR) mitteilt.

items.title: China may seek U.S. concessions on Taiwan in exchange for pressuring Russia – expert
items.teaser: China may have an interest in ending the Russian-Ukrainian war to preserve its economic ties with Europe, while expecting concessions from the United States on Taiwan in return.

items.title: How many countries have recognized the Holodomor as genocide? See all 32 on our map
items.teaser: More than half of them voted after Russia's full-scale invasion. See who voted and when, checked against each parliament's own text.

items.title: Zelenskyy addresses Americans on Thanksgiving
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy congratulated Americans on Thanksgiving on 26 November, thanking them for supporting Ukraine against Russia.

items.title: Ukrainian aviation strikes Russian troop hub in Huliaipole
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Forces carried out an airstrike on a Russian troop staging point in Huliaipole, Zaporizhzhia region.

items.title: Trump says he asked Putin to stop military aggression in Europe
items.teaser: Donald Trump says he asked Vladimir Putin during talks in China to stop military aggression across Europe and reach a peace agreement with Ukraine quickly.

items.title: Father and his three children evacuated from Nikopol under cover of darkness
items.teaser: White Angels police evacuated a 39-year-old father and his three children from frontline Nikopol after dark, marking the family's third evacuation attempt.

items.title: Ukrinform featured on interactive Map of Recommended Media
items.teaser: A total of 317 Ukrainian media outlets, including Ukrinform, have been added to the interactive Map of Recommended Media for the second half of 2026.

items.title: Germany follows Italy in warning Ukraine against "geographical" expansion of war
items.teaser: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul backs Ukraine's right to self-defence but warns against the conflict spreading geographically, citing risks to Baltic Sea shipping and the environment.

items.title: Trump tells Putin to 'pull back all military aggression' across Europe
items.teaser: "During my conversations in China with President Vladimir Putin of Russia, I spent a lot of time talking about the fact that I would like to see President Putin pull back all Military aggression against territories throughout Europe," U.S. President Donald Trump said.

items.title: Russland übergibt Überreste von 250 Soldaten an Ukraine
items.teaser: Russland hat der Ukraine 250 Leichen vermutlich von ukrainischen Soldaten übergeben, teilt der Stab für Gefangenenbelange auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Kyiv is reportedly weighing cuts to the Flamingo missile. But now steered like an FPV drone, it does a job the Neptune can’t
items.teaser: The Neptune hits more reliably at long range, but the Flamingo's 1,150-kg warhead is heavier than anything else Ukraine builds.

items.title: “Deliveries are still delayed”—Ukraine’s leader on the US Patriot missiles meant to stop Russian ballistic strikes
items.teaser: Zelenskyy told his country the key priority is speeding up partners' missile deliveries, then said Washington has brought no good news on that yet.

items.title: Large-scale power outage hits Russian-occupied Crimea, disrupts transport
items.teaser: The outage comes amid weeks of electricity shortages across the Russian-annexed Crimean Peninsula.

items.title: Ukrainian aircraft destroy Russian staging point in centre of Huliaipole – video
items.teaser: Ukrainian aircraft struck a Russian staging point in central Huliaipole, killing up to 20 soldiers and destroying ammunition, antennas and ground drones.

items.title: Ukraine receives $450 mln from World Bank with Japanese government support
items.teaser: Ukraine has received $450 million from the World Bank, backed by guarantees from the Japanese government, under two programs: RISE, to support businesses, and SURGE, to support reconstruction.

items.title: French presidential candidate: "The war in Ukraine is our war because we are targets of Putin"
items.teaser: French presidential candidate Raphaël Glucksmann says the war in Ukraine is also France's war, arguing that stopping aid to Kyiv would undermine the country's vital interests.

items.title: Vier Polizist:innen bei russischem Angriff in Saporischschja getötet
items.teaser: Infolge eines russischen Angriffs auf Saporischschja sind vier Kriminalpolizist:innen ums Leben gekommen.

items.title: Russian plans to reach Kramatorsk and Sloviansk by winter completely foiled – military
items.teaser: Russian forces had planned to reach Kramatorsk and Sloviansk before the start of winter, but actions by Ukraine’s Defense Forces have forced them to focus on stabilizing their own positions rather than advancing further.

items.title: World Bank provides Ukraine with US$450m to support businesses and reconstruction
items.teaser: The World Bank has provided Ukraine with US$450 million to support businesses and reconstruction, with funding disbursed based on the achievement of performance targets.

items.title: GPS disruptions reported in Estonia, Sweden and Finland when drone attacked Russian vessel
items.teaser: Severe GPS disruptions affect Stockholm, Tallinn and Helsinki, with interference also reported near Gotland and the Åland Islands during the weekend Ukraine struck a Russian vessel.

items.title: Zahl der Verletzten bei russischem Angriff auf Charkiw steigt auf acht, eine Person getötet
items.teaser: Die Zahl der Verletzten in Charkiw infolge eines russischen Angriffs ist auf acht gestiegen, eine Person ist gestorben.

items.title: Ukraine’s own probe blames Russian troops for a 2024 tear-gas attack—and the OPCW says Kyiv’s evidence handling meets its standards
items.teaser: Russia's envoy claimed the 79-page report rests on a fabricated post from a defunct Telegram channel, while 35 countries and the EU welcomed the report.

items.title: Injury toll from Russian attack on Kharkiv rises to eight, one killed
items.teaser: The number of people injured in a Russian attack on Kharkiv has risen to eight, while one person was killed.

items.title: Bundesanwaltschaft - Zwei mutmaßliche Mitglieder einer pro-iranischen Terrorgruppe in Köln und Heidelberg festgenommen
items.teaser: Im Zusammenhang mit einem geplanten Anschlag auf eine Synagoge in Köln sind zwei mutmaßliche Mitglieder einer pro-iranischen Terrorgruppe festgenommen worden.

items.title: 'Grandmaster of politics' who 'wants peace': Jared Kushner interview reveals how Trump's envoy sees Putin
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump's envoy and son-in-law, Jared Kushner, praised Russian President Vladimir Putin and repeated disputed Kremlin claims about Russia's war against Ukraine in a Nov. 25 interview with Politico, offering a glimpse into how one of Washington's key negotiators views Moscow

items.title: Resilience does not mean Ukrainians should have to cope alone
items.teaser: Ukrainians have shown extraordinary resilience in the face of Russia's full-scale invasion. But resilience cannot replace institutional responsibility. Protecting civilians now requires preparedness that anticipates threats, earns trust and is built with communities.

items.title: From laser to F-16 cannon: Ukraine shows six ways to down Russia’s jet drones in 13 days. But in October, a third got through
items.teaser: A laser and a ground robot joined the hunt, and a presidential adviser says it is too soon to discuss serial production of the laser.

items.title: Anschlag auf Synagoge in Köln geplant - Zwei mutmaßliche Islamisten festgenommen
items.teaser: Eine Gruppe soll einen Anschlag auf eine Kölner Synagoge geplant haben.

items.title: Ukraine repatriates 250 bodies Russia claims belong to Ukrainian soldiers
items.teaser: The recovery and return of fallen soldiers' corpses remains a major challenge.

items.title: Selenskyj: Russen seien dabei, Vorbereitungen auf neuen massiven Angriff auf Ukraine zu beenden
items.teaser: Russland sei dabei, Vorbereitungen auf einen neuen massiven Angriff auf die Ukraine zu beenden. „Nach Geheimdienstinformationen sollen Energieanlagen, Logistik und lebenswichtige Einrichtungen das Hauptziel des geplanten Angriffs werden“, schreibt der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj auf Facebook.

items.title: Italian PM warns Ukraine after attack on Russian vessel in Mediterranean Sea
items.teaser: Italian PM Giorgia Meloni has warned against the war spreading to the Mediterranean following Ukrainian strikes on Russian vessels near Libya's port of Benghazi.

items.title: Russia may stage new provocations against Poland during Christmas holidays – General Kraszewski
items.teaser: Russia may step up provocations against Poland ahead of the Christmas and New Year holidays, when public attention is focused on the festivities.

items.title: Russland: Sieben von zehn ermordeten Frauen Opfer häuslicher Gewalt
items.teaser: Der Krieg gegen die Ukraine hinterlässt auch in der Statistik zu häuslicher Gewalt in Russland Spuren. Eine Studie zeigt: Viele Täter sind Kriegsteilnehmer. Und Verfahren können ausgesetzt werden, wenn Beschuldigte in den Krieg ziehen. Von L. Becker.

items.title: Sie wissen, wie Coach Rapp tickt - Dynamo hat gleich zwei Pauli-Spione
items.teaser: Dresden braucht gegen St. Pauli einen Heimdreier - und zählt auf diese Erkenntnisse.

items.title: Mother of fallen U.S. volunteer hopes to publish in Ukraine children’s book inspired by her son
items.teaser: Laura Racy Miller, the mother of U.S. volunteer Hayden Fisher Miller, who was killed defending Ukraine, hopes to publish her children’s book Night of the Cricket in Ukraine. Inspired by her son, the story follows a cricket overcoming obstacles on its way to achieving its dream.

items.title: Generalstab meldet Treffer auf russischen Militärflugplatz „Marinowka“ und Transneft- Ölpumpstation
items.teaser: In der Nacht zum 26. November haben die Verteidigungskräfte der Ukraine den Militärflugplatz „Marinowka“ in der russischen Region Wolgograd mit „Neptun“-Raketen angegriffen. items.title: Large-scale power outage reported in Crimea
items.teaser: A major blackout has affected Russian-occupied Crimea; Sevastopol is completely without electricity and outages have been reported in dozens of settlements across the peninsula.

items.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Angriffe auf Kiew - Tote in Saporischschja
items.teaser: Russland hat die Ukraine wieder massiv angegriffen. Auch bei einem ukrainischen Drohnenangriff im russisch besetzten Teil von Saporischschja gab es Tote. Beide Seiten tauschten die Leichen gefallener Soldaten aus.

items.title: He allegedly photographed supplies for Ukrainian soldiers while wearing a medical mask. Lithuanian prosecutors suspect he had been spying for Russia since 2021
items.teaser: Prosecutors say the case over the photos pointed to years of paid information gathering for Moscow.

items.title: Russian attack on Odesa kills 70-year-old man
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked Odesa and its suburbs, damaging infrastructure and killing a 70-year-old man.

items.title: Bodies of 250 fallen Ukrainians repatriated from Russia
items.teaser: The bodies of 250 deceased people have been returned to Ukraine. Russia claims they are those of Ukrainian service members.

items.title: Trump und Rutte rufen Putin auf, Krieg gegen Ukraine nicht auszuweiten
items.teaser: US-Präsident Donald Trump und der NATO-Generalsekretär Mark Rutte haben nach ihrem Treffen in Florida am 25. November eine gemeinsame Erklärung veröffentlicht.

items.title: Ukraine strikes Russian airfield and Transneft oil hub
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck the Marinovka airfield in Russia’s Volgograd region with Neptune missiles overnight on November 26. A hit was also recorded at a Transneft oil pumping station in Bashkortostan, more than 1,000 kilometers from the Ukrainian border.

items.title: Ukraine repatriates 250 bodies that Russia claims are Ukrainian military personnel
items.teaser: Ukraine brought back the bodies of 250 fallen individuals – identified by Russia as Ukrainian military personnel – on 26 November with Red Cross support, forensic examination and identification is to follow.

items.title: Zelensky: Russia preparing for another massive attack on Ukraine
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky said Russian forces were completing preparations for another massive attack, with energy infrastructure, logistics and essential services likely to be targeted again.

items.title: Anschlagspläne auf Synagoge in Köln: Zwei Festnahmen
Russian strike kills four police investigators in Zaporizhzhia
items.teaser: Four investigators from the unit handling particularly serious crimes within the Main Directorate of the National Police in the Zaporizhzhia region were killed in a Russian attack on the city of Zaporizhzhia.

items.title: Merz fordert weitere Kürzungen der EU-Finanzen
items.teaser: Um mehr als 200 Milliarden Euro ist der EU-Haushaltsentwurf bereits gekürzt worden. Dem Kanzler reicht das aber noch nicht. Außerdem verknüpft Merz die schwierigen Verhandlungen weiterhin mit der Unterstützung für die Ukraine.

items.title: Russia prepares new mass attack on Ukraine's energy infrastructure, Zelensky says
items.teaser: While Russia’s attacks on Ukraine’s energy system have been ongoing throughout the year at a low level, Moscow has ramped up mass attacks to wipe out power plants, substations, and gas infrastructure for its fifth winter offensive during the full-scale invasion, cutting off power to households across the country.

items.title: Kushner blames Ukraine for stalling peace talks over ‘attack on Putin’s house’ in 2025
items.teaser: Jared Kushner, U.S .President Donald Trump’s son-in-law, has claimed that Ukraine is responsible for the delays in peace negotiations with Russia.

items.title: Ukrainian Neptune missiles strike Russian airbase housing Su-34 aircraft
items.teaser: Ukraine's defence forces struck the Marinovka airbase in Volgograd Oblast, where Su-34 bombers are based, and a Transneft oil pipeline station in Bashkortostan

items.title: Man who set himself on fire in Warsaw demanded equal treatment for Ukrainian citizens
items.teaser: According to Polish newspaper Fakt, the 22-year-old Ukrainian citizen who set himself on fire outside Warsaw's Presidential Palace on 25 November was protesting for equal treatment of Ukrainians in Poland and remains alive in hospital

items.title: North Korea closes its skies to Russian military transport planes and pauses missile and shell deliveries, says Ukraine’s intelligence
items.teaser: Kim Jong Un reportedly ordered the curbs himself over what a Moscow diplomat said about easing tension between the two Koreas.

items.title: Poland’s top diplomat calls Russian missiles near its border a direct threat—NATO is cool on shooting them over Ukraine
items.teaser: Downing Russian weapons over Ukraine at Kyiv's request would be necessary defense, Sikorski says, while Poland's defense ministry says NATO is not keen.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Russians are completing preparations for new massive strike
items.teaser: Ukrainian intelligence reports that Russia is preparing to target energy and logistics infrastructure, as well as critical facilities in cities and communities

items.title: Kushner wirft der Ukraine Scheitern der Verhandlungen wegen angeblichen „Angriffs auf Putins Residenz“ im Vorjahr vor
items.teaser: Jared Kushner, der Schwiegersohn des US-Präsidenten Donald Trump, erklärte, die Ukraine sei angeblich für die Verzögerung der Friedensverhandlungen mit Russland verantwortlich.

items.title: Russian drone hits university building in Kharkiv, killing woman
items.teaser: A Russian jet-powered drone struck a university building in Kharkiv’s Kyivskyi district, killing a woman.

items.title: 'Solidarity' and winter top EU agenda as leaders discuss new support for Ukraine
items.teaser: "Ukraine probably will face a winter which is like hell... they must know that Europe has their back money-wise, with everything we have," Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal said.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 10, injure 58 across Ukraine over past day, as ballistic missiles strike Kyiv
items.teaser: Russian forces launched an unspecified number of ballistic missiles, 113 drones, including 76 jet-powered ones, Gerbera drones, and Parody decoys at Ukraine overnight on Nov. 25, Ukraine's Air Force said.

items.title: Three injured and cars on fire after Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia
items.teaser: Three people have been injured and several cars caught fire after Russian forces attacked Zaporizhzhia's Kosmichnyi district with FPV drones on the afternoon of 26 November.

items.title: Ein Schuss kostet gerade einmal 3,50 Dollar: Eine ukrainische Laserwaffe hat erstmals eine 115.000 Dollar teure russische Jet-Drohne zerstört
items.teaser: Eine ukrainische Laserwaffe hat erstmals eine russische Jet-Drohne im Kampfeinsatz abgefangen. Das System soll künftig kritische Infrastruktur schützen.

items.title: Streit um EU-Haushalt: Warum die Slowakei blockieren will
items.teaser: Beim EU-Sondergipfel geht der slowakische Regierungschef Fico auf Konfrontation. Zusammen mit Polen, Ungarn und Tschechien will er die EU-Haushaltspläne blockieren - insbesondere die Ukraine-Hilfen. Innenpolitisch könnte ihm das nutzen. Von M. Allweiss.

items.title: Four police officers killed in Russian strike in Zaporizhzhia Oblast – photos
items.teaser: Three officers died at the scene, while their commander died in hospital the following day. All four were on duty when the Russian strike hit

items.title: Hungary to join International Coalition for the Return of Ukrainian Children
items.teaser: Hungary has decided to join the International Coalition for the Return of Ukrainian Children. This means that all 27 European Union member states are now part of the Coalition.

items.title: Trump und Rutte: Putin soll Ukraine-Krieg nicht "ausweiten"
items.teaser: Vor seinem Gespräch mit dem US-Präsidenten plädierte der NATO-Generalsekretär für mehr Druck auf Russlands Machthaber Putin. Nach dem Treffen klangen Trump und Rutte moderater.

items.title: Russia completely destroys major Ukrainian manufacturer of hygiene products
items.teaser: Following its fifth Russian attack, sanitary and hygiene product company Bloomy said its equipment is beyond repair, halting Ukrainian production across all five brands including Snow Panda, Nizhnyi Dotyk and Helper

items.title: Russian forces drop two aerial bombs on Sloviansk, killing one person, injuring another
items.teaser: Russian forces dropped two 250-kilogram aerial bombs on the city of Sloviansk in the Donetsk region, killing one man and injuring another.

items.title: "Terror 18": Nach Razzia bei Neonazi-Gruppe – Jugendliche mit Auflagen frei

items.title: Barvinivka in Zaporizhzhia region remains under Ukrainian control
items.teaser: Russian claims that their forces have captured the village of Barvinivka in the Zaporizhzhia region are false.

items.title: Ukrainian journalists outnumbered 30 to 1 by Russian propagandists during Oleshky evacuation, reporter says
items.teaser: According to Romakhlo, the Russian side attempted to portray Ukraine as responsible for the humanitarian crisis in Oleshky.

items.title: Ukraine-Hilfe polarisiert die Generaldebatte im Bundestag
items.teaser: Im Bundestag wurde über den Haushalt 2027 debattiert. Darin auch enthalten: rund zwölf Milliarden Euro Ukraine-Hilfe. Für die AfD ist das eine Veruntreuung von Steuergeldern, für Kanzler Merz die Verteidigung "unserer Freiheit". Von Nicole Markwald.

items.title: Ukraine's Blysk laser makes world first, shooting down Russian jet-powered drone
items.teaser: Ukraine's Blysk laser air defense system, developed by Carmine Sky, has shot down a Russian jet-powered Geran drone for the first time.

items.title: Verteidigungskräfte vereiteln russischen Durchbruchsversuch bei Dobropillja
items.teaser: Soldaten der 25. selbständigen Luftlandebrigade „Sitscheslaw“ haben in Zusammenarbeit mit benachbarten Einheiten der ukrainischen Streitkräfte einen Durchbruchsversuch russischer Angreifer im Raum des Dorfes Dobropillja im Landkreis Pokrowsk der Region Donezk vereitelt.

items.title: "Vicious circle": Ukraine says situation around Starshield remains unresolved
items.teaser: Ukrainian diplomat Denys Sienik said restrictions on Starshield in Ukraine remain unresolved, calling it a "vicious circle" putting civilians at risk.

items.title: Russians' tactics remain unchanged: they strike power lines and substations, we repair them – Zelenskyy
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on 25 November that Russia's tactics remain unchanged, targeting power lines and substations to disrupt electricity transmission.

items.title: Six photos from Ukraine included in TIME's Top 100 Photos of 2026
items.teaser: Six photographs from Ukraine have been included in the American magazine TIME's annual selection of the 100 most outstanding images of the year, TIME's Top 100 Photos of 2026.

items.title: Ukrainian combat laser intercepts Russian jet-powered drone for first time
items.teaser: So far, persistent cloud cover and fog over Kyiv had reportedly prevented the system from engaging Russian drones effectively.

items.title: Hungarian PM Magyar says Zelenskyy gave him gift honouring his great-grandfather
items.teaser: Hungarian PM Péter Magyar said Volodymyr Zelenskyy gifted him a 1942 newspaper mentioning his great-grandfather during his visit to Zakarpattia.

items.title: Zelensky waiting for US to set date for next round of peace talks
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said he was waiting for the United States to set a date for the next meeting of the negotiating teams, which should now be quadrilateral with Europe also taking part.

items.title: Ukraine's next election
items.teaser: A rushed election could also hand Moscow something it has so far failed to achieve on the battlefield: a Ukrainian leadership whose legitimacy can be systematically challenged.

items.title: Präsident Selenskyj trifft den estnischen Außenminister Magrus Tsahkna
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte heute nach dem Treffen mit dem estnischen Außenminister Margus Tsahkna auf Facebook, er erwarte von den USA die Bekanntgabe eines Termins für ein neues Treffen der Verhandlungsteams. Dieses Treffen solle im Vierer-Format unter Beteiligung Europas stattfinden.

items.title: Injury toll in Russian airstrike on Sloviansk rises to 10, one person killed
items.teaser: The number of people injured in a Russian airstrike on Sloviansk has risen to 10, with two people in critical condition.

items.title: Value of frozen Russian assets in Switzerland rises to over US$10bn
items.teaser: The value of Russian assets frozen in Switzerland rose by 15% to CHF 8.5 billion (US$10.2 billion) compared with April 2025, Bloomberg reported.

items.title: Black Sea port blockade could cost Ukraine $9.8 billion in 2027, study says
items.teaser: A year-long blockade of Ukraine's three major Black Sea ports could reduce the country's gross domestic product (GDP) by 4.1%, according to an economic assessment by the Center for Transport Strategies (CFTS).

items.title: AI expands Russia's ability to conduct global disinformation campaigns – expert
items.teaser: Russia is actively using artificial intelligence and other advanced technologies to expand the geographical reach of its disinformation campaigns.

items.title: Estonia deports Russian national over suspected ties to Russian intelligence
items.teaser: Anton Zuyev was deported on Nov. 24 at the recommendation of KAPO to prevent and counter potential threats to Estonia's national security, the agency said.

items.title: Anschlagsplan? Jugendliche unter Terrorverdacht festgenommen
items.teaser: Schon wieder stehen Minderjährige im Verdacht, Gewalttaten gegen Ausländer und politische Gegner geplant zu haben.

items.title: Russian drone attacks car in Kharkiv Oblast, killing two
items.teaser: A Russian drone struck a civilian car in Kharkiv Oblast's Zolochiv hromada on 25 November, killing two people, likely a local couple, Syniehubov said.

items.title: European Parliament approves 2027 EU budget, allocating €650 mln to service Ukraine Loan
items.teaser: On Wednesday, Members of the European Parliament (MEPs) gave final approval to the European Union's annual budget for 2027.

items.title: Ukraine and Hungary to hold first meeting of minority rights commission in early 2027
items.teaser: Ukraine and Hungary will co-chair a commission on national minority rights, with its first meeting planned for early 2027, Hungarian PM Anita Orbán has said.

items.title: Russischer Luftangriff auf Slowjansk: Zahl der Verletzten steigt auf zehn, ein Toter
items.teaser: Die Zahl der Verletzten in der Stadt Slowjansk infolge des russischen Luftangriffs ist auf zehn gestiegen, zwei Personen sind in schwerem Zustand, teilte der Leiter der Militärbehörde von Slowjansk, Wadym Ljach, auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Dnipro sets up additional emergency assistance points amid power supply problems
items.teaser: Emergency responders have set up additional assistance points for residents of Dnipro amid the difficult electricity supply situation in the city.

items.title: Poland plans no-fly zone near Ukraine border, asks NATO to intercept Russian missiles over Ukraine
items.teaser: The proposals come amid growing concerns over Russian aerial incursions into NATO territory, following a series of incidents involving Russian missiles and drones entering Polish airspace during attacks on Ukraine on Nov. 23 and 24.

items.title: Himera raises $5 million to expand military communications business
items.teaser: "This investment allows us to advance technologies that help Ukrainian defenders carry out their missions more effectively," said Misha Rudominski, Himera's co-founder and CEO.

items.title: Ground robot joins Ukraine’s hunt for Russia’s jet Shaheds, a third of which evaded interception in October. Brigade says it downed one
items.teaser: The shootdown came on the same day Ukraine's top military command met over how to stop these drones.

items.title: Ukrainian firm Carmine Sky builds a laser to guard critical infrastructure. Its Blysk downs Russia’s jet-powered Geran in world’s first kill
items.teaser: The laser guards a critical infrastructure site, and its maker is still testing it before any serial production.

items.title: Ukraine shoots down Russian jet-powered Geran drone with combat laser for first time – video
items.teaser: Ukraine has shot down a Russian jet-powered Geran drone with a Blysk combat laser for the first time while defending critical infrastructure, an expert has reported.

items.title: Russian army attacks sawmill in Chernihiv region, three injured
items.teaser: Russian forces struck a sawmill in the Chernihiv district, injuring three men.

items.title: Finland, Norway pledge nearly $60 million to support Ukraine's energy sector repairs
items.teaser: The money will be used to buy equipment needed to repair energy facilities damaged by Russian attacks across Ukraine.

items.title: Sawmill catches fire in Chernihiv Oblast after Russian attack, three men injured
items.teaser: Three men were injured after a Russian attack sparked a fire at a sawmill in the Chernihiv district on 25 November, Ukraine's emergency service reported.

items.title: Parliament backs Ukraine's joining management committee of special tribunal on Russian aggression
items.teaser: Upon joining the committee, Ukraine will have a say in setting the tribunal's policies, approving its budget, and addressing administrative matters.

items.title: Head of Zelenskyy's office says prisoner swap could take place in late November or early December
items.teaser: Zelenskyy’s chief of staff Kyrylo Budanov says the first prisoners of war could be brought back in late November or early December in an exchange involving more than 1,000 people.

items.title: Estnischer Außenminister: 650.000 russische Touristen reisten letztes Jahr in die EU ein – das ist nicht normal
items.teaser: Letztes Jahr reisten 650.000 russische Touristen in den Schengen-Raum ein. Angesichts der terroristischen Akte und Sabotageakte Russlands in europäischen Ländern sei das nicht normal, erklärte heute der estnische Außenminister Magrus Tsahkna auf einer Pressekonferenz in Kyjiw.

items.title: Russian forces strike Zaporizhzhia, sparking fire at transport company, injuring five
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked the Kosmichnyi district of Zaporizhzhia. A fire broke out at a motor transport company, and private houses were damaged. Five people were injured.

items.title: Russians attack energy infrastructure in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast again
items.teaser: Another Russian attack on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast's energy infrastructure left parts of Dnipro and four districts without power on 25 November, DTEK reported.

items.title: Ukrainian border guards repel Russian mechanised assault in northern Kharkiv Oblast – video
items.teaser: Ukrainian border guards have repelled a mechanised assault near Vovchanski Khutory, destroying a PTS-2 amphibious transporter, two infantry fighting vehicles and two quad bikes.

items.title: Poland could have intercepted Russian missiles, drones over Ukraine, but legal changes needed – ex-defense minister
items.teaser: Poland could have considered shooting down Russian missiles and drones over Ukrainian territory if they are heading toward Polish airspace. However, this would require resolving legal issues and establishing coordination with the Ukrainian side.

items.title: Poland says NATO refuses to shoot down drones over Ukraine due to "numerous complications"
items.teaser: Polish Deputy Defence Minister Cezary Tomczyk said NATO does not support shooting down Russian drones over Ukraine as it would create numerous complications.

items.title: Russia changes tactics against Ukraine’s grid to drag out repairs. Cluster warheads often strike switches and relays across substations, Ukrenergo says
items.teaser: Ukraine has protected its big autotransformers fairly well, so Russia goes after the secondary equipment around them, and replacements take a long time to arrive.

items.title: How Ukraine fought from inside Russian positions in Operation Vivaldi
items.teaser: The Kyiv Independent’s Asami Terajima and Nick Allard speak with commanders involved in Operation Vivaldi about how Ukrainian forces prepared and carried out the counteroffensive.

items.title: Ukrainian forces thwart Russian attempt to break through near Dobropillia
items.teaser: Fighters from the 25th Airborne Brigade, in coordination with other Ukrainian Armed Forces units, thwarted an attempt by Russian forces to break through near the settlement of Dobropillia in the Pokrovsk district, Donetsk region.

items.title: Footage shows two Rosneft refineries on fire hours after Putin called retaliation “inevitable”
items.teaser: Ukraine's military reportedly paused its refinery campaign in mid-October, but a Russian Telegram channel counted 12 refineries attacked in the three weeks before the Samara strikes.

items.title: Ukraine: Poland to set up no-fly zone near Ukraine border
items.teaser: Poland urged NATO allies to be vigilant at their borders after repeated Russian airspace incursions. Allies have also offered different opinions on Kyiv attacking Russian ships in Libya. Follow DW for the latest.

items.title: IIHF to appeal ruling allowing Russia's return to international hockey in Swiss court
items.teaser: "The decision (to appeal to the Swiss Federal Tribunal) is based on concerns around the independence of the impartiality of two of the three arbitrators on the CAS panel, especially following information that has recently come to light regarding potential links between the two arbitrators and Russia" the IIHF said in a

items.title: Ungarn-Ukraine: Peter Magyar und Wolodymyr Selenskyj wagen Neustart
items.teaser: Lange vergiftete Viktor Orbans prorussischer Kurs Ungarns Verhältnis zur Ukraine. Nun schaffen Premier Magyar und Präsident Selenskyj bei einem Treffen eine neue Vertrauensbasis - und vereinbaren konkrete Schritte.

items.title: Ukrainian forces thwart Russian assault south of Dobropillia – video
items.teaser: 25th Sicheslav Airborne Brigade has reported that Russian forces attempting to advance south of Dobropillia under cover of strong winds were stopped after FPV drone strikes and a minefield disabled their armoured vehicles.

items.title: 5 Russian aircraft hit at airfield in Russia's Nizhny Novgorod Oblast, General Staff says
items.teaser: Preliminary reports indicate that the attack hit three MiG-31 fighter jets and two Su-34 aircraft, according to Ukraine's General Staff.

items.title: Six injured, including child, in Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia – photos
items.teaser: Six people, including a child, have been injured in a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia's Kosmichnyi district. Around 10 houses, a warehouse and cars have been damaged.

items.title: Sybiha outlines three priorities for Ukraine Recovery Conference in Tallinn
items.teaser: The main priorities of the international Ukraine Recovery Conference, to be held in Tallinn in late January, will be supporting Ukraine's energy and transport sectors, securing funding and equipment, and developing mechanisms to insure against war risks.

items.title: Self-proclaimed Belarusian president denies that he knew Russian forces would advance on Kyiv from Belarus in 2022
items.teaser: In an interview with French magazine Le Point, self-proclaimed Belarusian president Alexander Lukashenko has denied knowing in 2022 that Russian troops stationed in Belarus would launch an offensive on Kyiv.

items.title: Verteidigungskräfte greifen Flugplatz Sawaslejka an: Fünf Flugzeuge, mit denen Russland die Ukraine attackiert, getroffen
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte haben den russischen Flugplatz Sawaslejka angegriffen, auf dem MiG-31K – Träger der Raketen Kinschal – stationiert sind.

items.title: Russian drone strikes energy facility in Poltava region, four injured
items.teaser: Four people were injured after a Russian drone struck an energy facility in the Poltava district.

items.title: Three injured in Russian drone strike on energy facility in Poltava Oblast
items.teaser: A Russian drone hit an energy facility in the Poltava district, injuring three people. An explosion was heard in Poltava shortly after air defence systems were reported operating.

items.title: Ukraine ready to accelerate implementation of agreements on rights of Hungarian minority – Sybiha
items.teaser: Ukraine is ready to accelerate the implementation of agreements on ensuring the linguistic, cultural and educational rights of the Hungarian national minority, as the necessary legal framework is already in place.

items.title: Russia cuts healthcare while the army’s budget soars. Defense gets $209 billion in 2027, 35% of the federal budget
items.teaser: The government can still add defense money during the year without asking parliament, an exiled Russian economist and former deputy finance minister said.

items.title: Poland plans to establish a no-fly zone near its border with Ukraine
items.teaser: Deputy Defence Minister Cezary Tomczyk has said Poland is preparing a decree to create a no-fly zone along its border with Ukraine at the turn of the year to help pilots identify and intercept incoming aerial threats.

items.title: In This Issue
items.teaser: Opening the Articles section, Jaye Ellis argues that civil liability law has been overlooked as an important element of holding international corporations to account. For Ellis, the reasonable person standard can bridge different normative orders and overcome common obstacles faced by plaintiffs. In the next article, T

items.title: Ex-soldier recruited by Russia’s GRU was caught meters from a bomb meant for Ukrainian special forces commander, SBU says
items.teaser: The ex-soldier parked a car with a bomb in its door outside the commander's home, with a dashcam in a second car set to film the blast, the SBU says.

items.title: Russen werfen eine 500-kg-Fliegerbombe auf Slowjansk ab
items.teaser: Die russische Besatzungsarmee hat eine 500 Kilogramm schwere FAB-500-Fliegerbombe auf das Zentrum von Slowjansk in der Region Donezk abgeworfen. Dabei wurde ein Mensch getötet und ein weiterer verletzt.

items.title: Russians strike community in Zhytomyr region again, injury toll rises to nine
items.teaser: Russian forces have launched a second attack on civilian infrastructure in the Malyn community, Zhytomyr region, killing one person and injuring nine others.

items.title: Most Russian ballistic and hypersonic missiles have gotten through since September, OSINT estimate says, as Patriot interceptors allies are financing sit unapproved
items.teaser: Ukraine's Air Force said in early November it was short of PAC-3 interceptors. About 40 are among the Patriot missiles US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has yet to approve, the FT reports.

items.title: Russian drone damages Dovzhenko Film Studio hostel in Kyiv – video, photos
items.teaser: Dovzhenko Film Studio has reported that an overnight Russian drone crash on 24-25 November blew out windows from the ground to the eighth floor of its hostel without injuring residents.

items.title: Black Friday bei Temu, Shein & Co: Wenn das Schnäppchen beim Zoll landet
items.teaser: Markensneaker für 39 Euro, dann kommt Post vom Zoll. Die EU-Kommission wirft Temu vor, zu wenig gegen illegale Angebote zu tun. Und die Kunden? Was diese von Verkäufer und Marktplatz verlangen können, erläutert

items.title: "She was the guardian of her family": woman injured in Russian strike on central Kryvyi Rih dies in hospital
items.teaser: Svitlana Kuropiatnik, who was injured in a Russian attack on central Kryvyi Rih on 20 November, has died in hospital. Doctors fought to save her life for five days but were unable to save her.

items.title: Khmara, Stoltenberg discuss strengthening Ukraine's air defenses and supporting defense industry
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara met with Norwegian Finance Minister Jens Stoltenberg during an official visit to Oslo to discuss strengthening Ukraine's air defenses and supporting the country’s defense industry.

items.title: Why Indian nationals are still ending up in Russia's war on Ukraine
items.teaser: Whether through deception or desperation, Indians continue to be drawn into Russia's war in Ukraine. What can New Delhi do to protect its citizens from ending up fighting in Ukraine?

items.title: Was über die rechtsextremistische Gruppe "Terror 18" bekannt ist
items.teaser: Sie sind fast noch Kinder und planten laut Bundesanwaltschaft schwerste Straftaten, etwa auf eine Flüchtlingsunterkunft. Nun gingen Ermittler gegen mutmaßliche Mitglieder der rechtsextremistischen Gruppe "Terror 18" vor. Was ist bekannt? Von Max Bauer.

items.title: How good is Ukraine’s Flamingo missile? Only 12 of 53 known launches strike their targets, OSINT count shows
items.teaser: The count lands as Kyiv denies reports it will move money from the Flamingo to the Neptune.

items.title: Ukrainische Verteidigungskräfte attackieren gleich zwei Raffinerien in Russland
items.teaser: Die Verteidigungskräfte der Ukraine haben in Zusammenarbeit mit der Freischärlerbewegung „Tschorna Iskra“ (Schwarzer Funke – deu.) zwei Ölraffinerien in der russischen Region Samara angegriffen.

items.title: Bundesanwaltschaft - Festnahme von drei mutmaßlichen Mitgliedern von rechtsextremistischer Gruppe
items.teaser: Die Bundesanwaltschaft hat drei mutmaßliche Mitglieder einer rechtsextremistischen Vereinigung festnehmen lassen. Wie die Behörde mitteilte, handelt es sich um Jugendliche aus Brandenburg, Niedersachsen und Schleswig-Holstein.

items.title: Russia drops 500-kg FAB-500 bomb on Sloviansk
items.teaser: Russian forces have dropped a 500-kilogram FAB-500 glide bomb on central Sloviansk in the Donetsk region, killing one person and injuring another.

items.title: Notstromabschaltungen in fünf Regionen infolge russischer Angriffe
items.teaser: Nach dem russischen Drohnen- und Raketenangriff wurden am Mittwoch, dem 25. November, in fünf Regionen der Ukraine Stromausfälle gemeldet.

items.title: Ukraine ready for next POW exchange, Coordination Headquarters secretary says
items.teaser: Dmytro Usov, secretary of Ukraine’s Coordination Headquarters for the Treatment of Prisoners of War, visited Russian POWs at a detention camp.

items.title: Ukraine: Industrial attacks and anger at Russia as Ukraine's allies justify defense aid, argue over military action in Libya
items.teaser: Moscow and Kyiv traded infrastructure attacks as allies argued over Ukraine's actions in Libya. Poland says it is puzzled by the lack of a US response to Russian incursions in its airspace. Follow DW for the latest.

items.title: Ukraine’s first Lynx IFVs arrive with airburst shells and a counter-drone role they weren’t optimized for
items.teaser: Troops plan to fire 30mm airburst rounds at enemy drones, though The War Zone notes the vehicle has no visible radar.
